descriptionChirho: A place of grazing or feeding for livestock; pasturage, pasture-land. Used both literally of physical grazing fields (Gen 47:4 'your servants have no pasture for their flocks'; 1 Chr 4:39-41 seeking pasture for flocks) and in prophetic/poetic imagery (Isa 32:14; Ezek 34:14,18 'good pasture on the mountains'; Joel 1:18; Nah 2:11). Cognate with ra'ah 'to pasture/tend.' Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm: arb marAAn, deu Weide, fra paturage, hin charagah, kor mokchoji, spa pasto.
